Use the bathroom environment and vanity from Image 1<Picture 2> as the fixed scene and product reference throughout the entire sequence. Preserve the exact vanity design, double-basin ceramic integrated countertop, warm metallic faucets, white ceramic basins, countertop thickness, wood cabinet structure, white countertop surface, metal edge trim, warm recessed light slot, narrow central vertical wood strip, small circular emblem, and the asymmetric cabinet-door textures consistently. Maintain the premium new-Chinese-style material language and the product’s real structural details with clean, accurate geometry.

Use the woman from Image 2<Picture 1> as the fixed character reference throughout the entire sequence. Preserve her identity, hand appearance, skin tone, body proportions, hairstyle, dark brown halter dress, jewelry, and overall refined visual temperament consistently. In these product shots, only a brief partial hand appearance is needed when specified.

Scene Atmosphere:

A premium product-focused bathroom commercial sequence set inside the same refined new-Chinese-style vanity space. The overall mood is controlled, elegant, and detail-oriented, with warm architectural lighting and a strong luxury-finish presentation. The emphasis is on material quality, ceramic craftsmanship, wood texture, edge detailing, structural precision, and restrained branding details.

Character Description:

The same elegant East Asian woman from the reference remains part of the sequence, but the product is the primary visual hero. Her presence is minimal and supportive. When her hand briefly enters the frame, the motion should feel natural, light, and restrained, as if testing the water temperature in a calm, everyday manner.

Action Script:

Shot 1:

Cut directly to the left basin.

Warm water flows steadily from the metallic faucet into the white ceramic basin.

The camera slowly pushes forward, clearly revealing the basin depth, rounded inner corners, glaze finish, drain opening, and the thickness of the countertop.

From the edge of the frame, the woman’s hand briefly enters the water stream, lightly feels the water temperature, and then naturally withdraws.

Present the basin as a clean premium ceramic product shot with clear functional realism and elegant material rendering.

Display the on-screen subtitle: “陶瓷一体盆”.

Shot 2:

Move to a close product detail shot near the right-side cabinet corner.

The camera travels slowly along the cabinet structure, passing across the white countertop edge, the wooden side panel, the metal trim, and the horizontal cabinet face.

Clearly reveal the seam transitions, corner craftsmanship, wood grain, and the quality of the recessed light-slot construction.

Keep the product detailing crisp and precise so that the edge finishing and joinery become the visual focus.

Display the on-screen subtitle: “精工收边｜细腻木纹”.

Shot 3:

Show a frontal close product shot centered on the cabinet’s narrow vertical wood strip and the small circular emblem.

At the same time, include the two asymmetric cabinet-door textures on both sides: the left side features a fine horizontal wood / grille-like texture, while the right side features a restrained fine-line grid wood texture.

Above them, the continuous warm recessed light strip runs horizontally across the cabinet.

Treat the emblem as a refined identification detail rather than a dominant decorative centerpiece.

Present the overall cabinet face faithfully, with the narrow central strip and small circular emblem accurately positioned and the surrounding panel textures clearly readable.

Display the on-screen subtitle: “全实木柜体”.

Camera Language:

Shot 1:

Use a 70mm close product shot of the basin with a three-quarter overhead composition.

Apply a slow axial push-in.

Keep focus continuously on the basin body and faucet, with the water flow and ceramic surface reading clearly.

Shot 2:

Use an 85–100mm close product shot from an oblique side angle.

Track laterally along the cabinet structure with controlled depth of field.

Let the camera movement stay slow, smooth, and deliberate so the viewer can study the material transitions and construction details.

Shot 3:

Use an 85–100mm frontal close product shot.

Center the narrow vertical strip and small circular emblem.

Retain enough of both cabinet doors to clearly show the asymmetric texture treatment on the left and right sides.

Use only an extremely subtle push-in so the emblem and structural layout remain calm, accurate, and premium.

Lighting Reference:

Use stable warm architectural lighting consistent with the fixed bathroom reference.

In Shot 1, keep the ceramic basin, flowing water, glaze surface, and metallic faucet cleanly illuminated with controlled highlights and natural reflections.

In Shot 2, use precise lighting that reveals the white countertop edge, wood grain, metal trim, seams, corners, and recessed light-slot craftsmanship clearly and faithfully.

In Shot 3, maintain even premium illumination across the central vertical strip, small circular emblem, asymmetric cabinet textures, and the continuous warm light band above, ensuring that each surface remains distinct and clearly readable.

Sound Reference:

Shot 1 emphasizes the sound of flowing water, while the music drops to a lower level. Add a brief soft hand-to-water contact sound as the woman tests the temperature.

Shot 2 uses subtle low wooden tonal texture combined with delicate metallic high-frequency detail to support the craftsmanship close-up.

Shot 3 features a single low, restrained wooden impact accent that lands with quiet confidence and emphasizes the solidity of the full solid-wood cabinet.
